notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1958 fire item is quoted from The Evening Independent on an enthusiast site; the page dates it October 12, 1958. I did not check the newspaper itself. The 2005 bid appears only on that same site (dated September 14, 2005); I found no buyer, sale record or government auction listing. The 2015 report excerpt is headed '2015 & beginning 2016'. It lists Salem #268 (standing) and #318 (removed) but names no county, so it is not known whether either is this Taylor County tower. The status 'standing' in the record comes from the OSM and eastern lookouts records; no dated source I read confirms it. The FFLA Florida caches in data/raw/ffla have no Salem entry. The title and publisher for source 2 come from the URL and search results, not the document cover. Suggested checks: a Florida Forest Service public-records request for the 2005 sale and tower history; the Florida lookout association about Salem #268 and #318; OSM node 10012727105 (tagged tower:type observation). No corrections proposed.
